text.p: These are some of the leading sotries in the Greek Cypriot press on Monday according to the semi-official Cyprus News Agency. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The decision of the U.N. secretary-general to call a meeting between President Glafcos Clerides and Turkish-Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash within the first six months of 1997 has been made official.
- Members of the European Union have legal concerns over what the model for a solution to the Cyprus problem should be.

- Lack of progress and the intervention of Pentagon members in favour of the Turkish position were two of the reasons why U.S. President Bill Clinton did not make any reference to the Cyprus problem in his speech to the Congres last week.
